output.level_0: The API gateway crashes nightly, leaving store managers with stale order suggestions.
output.level_1: No API gateway exists, so the ordering system cannot pull fresh forecast data.
output.level_2: A human manually copies forecast outputs into the ordering system every morning.
output.level_3: The API gateway automatically serves forecast data to the ordering system on schedule.
output.level_4: The governed API gateway logs every request and enforces strict access controls.
